description: Leaves obovate, dentate, auriculate at base, hirsute above and below; deep green, usually with whitish area in centre, above; ca 7–25 by 3–10 cm with 1–2(–6) cm long petiole. Racemes erect, ca 10–12-flowered, 9–12 cm long. Flowers 3 cm across with 5–15 mm long pedicel. Sepals hirsute. Petals yellow. Carpels 2–4 usually 3, with 2–6 ovules. Follicles enclosed by the sepals; seeds finely echinate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Acrotrema costatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 104. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Woody climber. Leaves chartaceous, broadly ovate to suborbicular, 5.5–6(–11) by 4–5(–9) cm; apex acute or rounded; base truncate or subcordate; margin remotely serrulate; puberulous above; stellate-tomentose beneath; petiole 1.5–2 cm long. Inflorescence cymose axillary, 3- or 4-times branched, stellate-tomentose. Sepals 5, ovate, 4–5 mm long. Petals 5, brownish yellow, obtuse or suborbicular, 5–7 mm long. Stamens numerous. Ovary globose, densely pilose. Fruit ovoid to subglobose, 3–4 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Actinidia latifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 140. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Woody climber; pith solid, firm. Leaves chartaceous, oblong-lanceolateto ovate-oblong, 6–10.5 by 1.2–4(–4.5) cm; apex acuminate; base cuneate or subrounded; margin laxly serrulate: glabrous on both surfaces; petiole 1–2.5 cm long. Flowers polygamous, axillary, solitary or 2–4 in small fascicles. Sepals 5, oblong, 3–4 mm long. Petals 5. yellowish, ovate-oblong, 4–6 mm long. Stamens numerous; filaments slender 2.5–3 mm long. Ovary ovoid spherical, 3–4 mm long, pilose; styles about 20.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Actinidia rubricaulis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 140. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or tree, 5–15 m high. Leaves oblong-lanceolate to elliptic; 5–11(–15) by 2.5–4(–5) cm; apex acuminate or acute; base cuneate; petiole 3–7 mm long. Pedicels 2.5–5 cm long, slender. Bracteoles 2, caducous. Sepals ovate, densely sericeous, 7–10 mm long. Petals pinkish lanceolate, 1–1.5 cm long. Stamens 30–40; anthers 3–4 mm long, densely sericeous. Ovary conical, 3–5-locular, sericeous; style appressed hairy.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adinandra integerrima. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 151. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree, to 25 m high. Leaves coriaceous, narrowly oblong-lanceolate, 6–14(–20) by 2.5–5(–6) cm; apex acuminate; base obtuse; margin entire; petiole 1–1.5(–2.5) cm long. Flowers axillary, solitary or in pairs. Pedicels 2–2.5 cm long. Bracteoles 2, a short distance below the calyx, alternate, caducous. Sepals glabrous, ovate, acute, 4–8 mm long. Petals white, glabrous, oblong-obovate, 10–12 mm long. Stamens about 20; anthers pilose. Ovary glabrous, 4-locular; style simple.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adinandra laotica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 152. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or small tree, 4–15 m high. Leaves oblong-elliptic, 5–9(–11) by 2.5–4.5(–5.5) cm; apex acute or obtusely rounded; base cuneate or rounded; petiole 5–8 mm long. Pedicel 0.5–1.2(–2) cm long, stout. Bracteoles 2, caducous. Sepals ovate, 7–8 mm long. Petals ovate, 10–11 mm long. Stamens about 35; anthers 4–5 mm long. Ovary subglobose, 4–5-locular, pubescent; stigma 4–5-parted. Fruit globose, 1 cm across.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adinandra oblonga. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 151. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree, to 30 m high. Leaves coriaceous, broadly oblong-elliptic, 9–15 by 4–7 cm long; apex obtuse or subrounded; base acute; margin entire or finely serrulate above; petiole 1.5–2 cm long. Flowers axillary, mostly solitary. Pedicels 3–4.5 cm long. Bracteoles 2, opposite, persistent at anthesis. Sepals glabrous, ovate, rounded, 5–7 mm long. Petals obovate, 10–15 mm long. Stamens 30–40, 3–4-seriate; anthers oblong, pubescent. Ovary pubescent or glabrescent, 3-locular; style simple.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adinandra sarosanthera. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 152. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Liana or scrambling shrub, sometimes a small tree. Petiole 2–9 cm, densely pubescent. Leaflets ± coriaceous, base rounded, apex blunt–acuminate, entire, more or less densely ferruginous–tomentose especially beneath, ± triplinerved with 5–6 pairs of nerves; lateral leaflets oblique elliptic, 5–13 by 2–6 cm, terminal ones elliptic to obovate, 7–20 by 3–10 cm. Panicles up to 8–10 cm long, tomentose. Sepals ca 1.5 mm. Petals ca 2.5 mm. Carpels (3–)5. Fruits 15–25 by 7.5–12.5 mm, narrowed at the base, long beaked at the apex, papillose, tomentose. Seed obovoid, the basal half covered by the arillode.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Agelaea borneensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 120. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Liana or climbing shrub. Petiole 5–9 cm, glabrous. Leaflets coriaceous, basecuneate to rounded, apex blunt-acuminate, entire, glabrous or sometimes tomentose on the nerves beneath, triplinerved with about 4 pairs of nerves in the upper half; lateral leaflets usually very oblique, ovate, 8–18 by 4–10 cm, terminal ones obovate, 10–30 by 4–12 cm. Panicles 2–6 cm long, tomentose. Sepals 2 mm, obtuse. Petals 5 mm. Carpels (4–)5. Fruits 10–25 by 5–10 mm, narrowed at the base, rounded or shortly beaked at the apex, rugulose to warty, tomentose. Seed obovoid; arillode covering ⅓–¾ of the surface.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Agelaea trinervis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 119. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree, 5–15 m tall. Leaves lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 7–15 by2.5–5 cm; apex acute, rarely rounded or obtuse; base cuneate; petiole 2–3 cm long. Bracteoles 2, subtending the calyx. Calyx lobes ovate or rounded, 1–1.5 cm long, unequal. Petals ovate, 1.5–2 cm long, acute at the apex, constricted below the middle, shortly connate at the base into a tube. Stamens 1.2–1.5 cm long. Fruit globular or ovoid, 2 cm across.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anneslea fragrans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 157. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herb, 40–60(–70) cm. Scales (3–)5(–7) mm long, (5–)10–22-nerved. Leaves linear-lanceolate, acute (filiform tip 6–13 mm), (13–)17–27(–45) by (0.45–)0.6–1.3(–1.5) cm; nerves (13–)18–80(–92), (3–)5 of which are more prominent; sheath not marked. Racemes pendulous, almost always with a tuft of sterile bracts at base, with 2–12 side branches mostly emerging from between sterile bracts; 15–25(–32) flowers along each branch. Bracts narrowly triangular to lanceolate, acute (filiform tip up to 0.5 mm); sterile bracts up to 20 by 4 mm, mostly smaller, fertile ones 2–10(–16) by 1–1.5 mm, 3(–5)-nerved. Flowers 1, 2–1, 4(–1.9) cm, white or yellow with recurved perianth. Sepals 3.3–4.5 by 0.6–1 mm, 3-nerved, cusp 0.3–0.4(–0.5) by 0.1 mm. Petals all equal, 3.3–4.5 by 0.5–0.6(–1) mm, (1–)3(–5)-nerved, cusp 0.3(–0.6) by 0.1 mm. Column 0.5–1.1 by 0.2–0.3 mm, strongly curved, rarely straight. Stamens 3.2–3.5(–4) by 0.7–1.2(–1.4) mm; anthers elongate-semielliptic in cross section, base sagittate with equal to slightly unequal lobes 0.2–0.3 mm long, connective prolonged for 0.4–0.7 mm. Ovary 8–11 by 0.8–1 mm. Free part of style 3.6–4 by 0.2 mm with 2 more or less obscure longitudinal ribs. Stigma broadened at base, either flattened, orbicular to irregularly quadrangular, sometimes 3-lobed, or conical. Fruit 1.2–1.5 by 1 mm, green. Seeds regularly alveolate to nearly smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Apostasia nuda. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 137. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herb 20–50 cm. Scales 2.5–10 mm long, 5–10-nerved. Leaves ovate-oblong to linear, acute to acuminate (with a tip 0.5–2 cm), (7.5–)11–35 by 1–2(–3 cm); margin sometimes minutely dentate; nerves 20–37, 3–5 of which are more prominent; sheath often marked. Racemes pendulous, with 1–5 side branches; 10–20 flowers per branch. Bracts ovate to ovate-lanceolate, acute, 0.2–5 cm long, 3–13-nerved, lower ones with a filiform tip 2 mm long. Flowers 1.8–3.8 cm long, usually yellow, sometimes white. Sepals 6.5–11 by 1.2–2.2 mm, median sometimes smaller, 3–5-nerved, cusp 0.5–1.5 by 0.1–0.4 mm. Petals 6.5–11 by 1–2 mm, 3–5-nerved, cusp 0.4–0.8 by 0.1–0.2 mm, median petal up to 2.2 mm wide. Column 0.8–2 by 0.3–0.5 mm, straight or strongly curved at base, hardly flattened and with 2 longitudinal projecting wings at the staminodial side, to flattened and enlarged just below the middle of the staminode; enlarged part elliptic to quadrangular in outline, with 2 longitudinal ridges to small wings separated by a groove at the staminodial side. Stamens (3–)4–6.5 by (0.7–)1–1.5 mm; free part of filaments (0.6–)1–2 by 0.2 mm, longer anther cell often sterile at tip, 0.2–0.4 mm longer at base and 0.1–0.3 mm at tip; shorten one entirely adnate to longer one, or the apical portion up to 0.1 mm free. Staminode 2.5–4.5 by 0.2 mm; free apical portion with an obtuse tip, up to 0.4 mm long. Ovary 10–20 by 1–1.7mm. Free parts of style 4.5–6 by 0.3–0.4 mm, with 4–6 more or less distinct longitudinal ribs; overtopping staminode by up to 1 mm. Stigma slightly enlarged, shallowly 3-lobed to suborbicular. Fruit 20 by 1.5–2(–2.6) mm. Seeds alveolate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Apostasia odorata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 134. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herb, 10–100 cm. Scales 2–10 mm long, 5–15-nerved. Leaves linear, 10–50 by 0.3–1.8(–2) cm, acute (filiform tip up to 2 cm); entire or minutely dentate and glandular (hand lens); with 15–60 nerves, 3 or 5 of which are more prominent; sheath not marked. Racemes pendent, sometimes±erect, with 1–6 side branches; 5–25(–30) flowers along each branch. Bracts triangular to lanceolate, acute, usually lower ones with a filiform tip up to 0.5(–0.9) mm, margin as that of the leaves, 2–15(–24) mm long, (1–)3–7(–10)-nerved. Flowers 1–2.2(–2.7) cm long, yellow, rarely whitish. Sepals 4–6.5 by 0.6–1.7 mm, 3–5(–7)-nerved, cusp 0.4–1.2(–1.7) by 0.1–0.25 mm. Petals 3.7–6 by 0.5–1.5 mm, (1–)3(–5)-nerved, cusp 0.2–0.8(–1.2) by 0.1 mm, median one sometimes broader and more convex. Column straight to strongly curved, 0.7–1.5(–1.8) by 0.2–0.6(–0.7) mm. Stamens (2–)3–4(–5) by 0.6–1 mm; free parts of filaments 0.5–1 by 0.2–0.25 mm; anthers with an unequally bilobed to (oblique) entire tip; the longer anther cell opposite the staminode 0.1–0.4(–1) mm longer at base and up to 0.5 mm longer at apex; the shorter anther cell free from the longer one by 0–0.3 mm at tip. Staminode 1.3–3(–4) by 0.2–0.6 mm; entirely adnate or with an obtuse tip up to 1 mm free. Ovary 10–22 by 1–2 mm. Free part of style straight, occasionally curved, 2.5–4.8 by 0.2–0.5 mm, sometimes irregularly longitudinally ribbed. Stigma 2–3 lobed, sometimes suborbicular. Fruit 12–25 by 1.4–2 mm. Seeds alveolate to nearly smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Apostasia wallichii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 135. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Monoecious plants (inflorescences bisexual); length from fusion with host root to top of inflorescences (3–)5–10(–15) cm. Tubers single or several together in a mass, branching from the base. Single tubers obconical, narrow at base, broadening near top to (1–)1.7(–2) cm, length (1.1–)2.5(–3.5) cm. Leaves 3–7, distichous, slightly imbricate, ovate, obtuse or emarginate, cucullate, 1–2 cm by 0.7–1.5 cm. Inflorescence: ♀ part ovoid (1.0–)1.5(–2.5) cm by (0.5–)1.0(–2.3) cm; ♂ flowers 10–20, sessile in a zone 0.5–2 cm high just below 2 part, (3–)4–5(–8)–merous, slightly to conspicuously zygomorphic on account of lateral elongation. A 4-merous flower has two narrow, ovate, acute lateral tepals and two wide, truncate, almost square median tepals, 1.5–2 mm long. Synandrium about 1 mm long, slightly compressed, lateral width 1.5–2 mm, anterior-posterior width 0.5–0.7 mm. Anther loculi 16–20, parallel, running from base to top of synandrium.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Balanophora abbreviata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 178. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Dioecious plants. Tuber from fusion with host root repeatedly branched into elongated, more or less cylindrical parts, thus forming an entangled mass of branches up to 20 cm diam.; single tuber branch cylindrical, 0.9–1.3 cm diam.; tuber masses apparently perennial. Leaves 15–35, spirally arranged. In other characters agreeing with var. indica.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Balanophora fungosa minor. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 180. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Dioecious plants; length from fusion with host root to top of inflorescence (6–)10–16(–20) cm. Tubers single or a few together in a mass, branching from the base; single tuber 1–2.5 cm wide. Stem slender, 0.7–0.9 cm diam. In fresh condition. Leaves (6–)10–20(–34), spirally arranged or subopposite, adpressed to the stem, 2.5–4.5 cm long and 1.5–2.5 cm wide. ♂ inflorescence ovoid to ellipsoid, 1.8–2.5(–4.5) cm by 1.5–2.1 cm; flowers subtended by one bract-each, the bracts fused together, thus forming a number of hexagonal pits, from the bottom of which the pedicellate flowers appear. Pedicels (3–)5–7 mm. ♂ flower 3-merous with tepals triangular, up to 2.5. mm long and 4–5 mm wide. Anthers 3, forming a flat, depressed synandrium, transversally opening. ♀ inflorescence (1–)2–4(–4.5)cm by (0.5–)1–2(–2.5) cm, ovoid or ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Balanophora harlandii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 178. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Dioecious plants (inflorescences unisexual); length from fusion withhost root to top of inflorescence 10–25 cm. Tubers in a mass branching from the base; single tuber subspherical-ellipsoid, 1.9–4.3 cm by 1.7–2.6 cm; surface of tubers fine granular with few to numerous stellate warts. Leaves 3–4(–6), distichous, well spaced, patent. ♂ inflorescence long-ellipsoid, 5–9 cm by 1.5–2.5 cm with flowers expanded. Bracts truncate, 3 mm long and 5 mm wide, sometimes with the middle part reduced and thus appearing like two teeth. Pedicels (1.5–)2–3(–6) mm. 3 flowers zygomorphic on account of lateral elongation and correspondingly compressed in anterior-posterior direction, 4–5(–9–14)–merous. A normally developed 4-merous flower has two narrow, ovate, acute, lateral tepals, 3–3.5 mm by 1.5–2 mm and two wide, nearly square, truncate median tepals 3–3.5 mm by 3–4 mm. Synandrium laterally elongated, somewhat compressed. Anther cells 16–20 or more, parallel, always running from base to top of synandrium, opening longitudinally. ♂ inflorescence long-ellipsoid or almost cylindrical with obtuse top part, (1–)4–6(–7) cm by (0.5–)1–1.5(–2) cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Balanophora latisepala. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 180. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Dioecious plants (inflorescences unisexual), deep crimson to dark red, turning purple. Length of ♂ plants from fusion with host root to top of inflorescence (8–)10–20(–30) cm, of ♀ plants (7.5–)10–15(–20) cm. Tubers in a mass branching almost from the base. Single tuber subspherical or slightly longer than wide, 1–3 cm by 1–2.5 cm. Surface fine granular with stellate warts. Leaves opposite, decussate in 2–7 pairs, 2–2.5 cm by 1–1.5 cm. ♂ inflorescence (3–)6–12(–18) cm long and (0.5–)1–1.5(–2) cm wide, slender and tapering. Bracts absent or each bract reduced to 2 short, blunt bodies below the flower. Pedicels absent or extremely short, less than 1 mm. ♀ Flowers zygomorphic on account of slight lateral elongation, normally 6-merous and then with 2 truncate, median tepals and 4 acute, lateral tepals: sometimes 4–5–merous or 7–12-merous flowers are found, especially towards the proximal and distal parts of inflorescences. Tepals 2–3 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, subequal in size, or the 2 median ones slightly wider than the 4 lateral ones. Synandrium much depressed, low-domeshaped, subcircular or slightly elliptic, being laterally elongated, anterior-posterior width 4.5–5 mm, lateral width 6 mm. Anther cells often divided into smaller locelli about 2 times longer than wide. ♂ inflorescence (2–)3–5(–6) cm long and (0.8–)1.5–2(–3) cm wide, ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Balanophora laxiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 181. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree with a broadly pyramidal crown. Bark whitish, scaly. Leaves on mainshoots up to 1.2 cm long, ending in a minute spine, those on lateral shoots 0.6–0.8 by 0.2–0.3 cm, tapering towards the tip and terminated by a sharp tooth, glaucous beneath. Cones ellipsoid, 0.6–1.2 cm long, on short, four-sided, slender shoots; scales 6, woody, drying black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Calocedrus macrolepis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 196. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or small tree, 2–10 m high. Leaves chartaceous, oblong-ellipticor elliptic, 6–9 by 2.5–4 cm; apex acute or acuminate; base cuneate to rounded; margin crenate or crenulate; petiole 4–7 mm long. Bracteoles and sepals not clearly differentiated, 10–11, ovate to rounded, 3–5.5 mm long. Petals white, 5, obovate to broadly elliptic, 8–13 mm long, concave; apex rounded. Filaments of the outer stamens united their whole length to form a tube irregularly dentate above; anthers attached on the sinus; inner stamens 3–5, free. Ovary densely tomentose, 4 mm long; style short and stout, 3-branched. Capsule subglobose, 2.8 cm high, 3-sulcate with 1 large seed in each locule, or rounded with only 1 seed developed.

description: Tree to 10 m high. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to broadly elliptic, 9–15 by 3.5–6.5 cm; apex acute or rounded, abruptly acuminate; base cuneate; petiole 0.5 cm long. Flowers solitary at the end of branchlets. Bracteoles 2 or 3, caducous. Sepals 5 or 6, broadly ovate or orbicular, 5–8 mm long. Petals 5, white, ovate to orbicular, connate below, 1.2–1.5 cm long. Outer stamens connate below and adnate to the corolla. Ovary glabrous; styles 5, free to the base.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Camellia pleurocarpa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 146. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub, small or tall tree, lip to 15 m high. Leaves thin coriaceous, broadly elliptic, 8–14(–22) by 3.5–5.5(–7.5) cm; apex acuminate; base broadly cuneate or rounded. Bracteoles 2–3, caducous, ovate, about 2 mm long. Sepals 5–6, ovate to orbicular, 3–5 mm long. Petals yellowish white, 5–6(–8), connate below, broadly ovate or orbicular, 1–2 cm long. Outer stamens shortly connate at the base. Ovary densely hairy, 3–4 mm long. Capsule depressed globose, 1.1–1.5 cm high, 3- or 2-lobed, with 1 or 2 seeds in each locule.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Camellia sinensis assamica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 148. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or small tree, 2–7 m high. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic tobroadly elliptic, 9–15 by 3–6.5 cm; apex acute or shortly acuminate; base cuneate, entire; margin elsewhere serrulate or subentire. Bracteoles 2–3, caducous. Sepals orbicular, 2–4 mm long. Petals white, about 11, connate below, oval or obovate, 1.2–3.5 cm long. Ovary glabrescent, 2–3 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Camellia taliensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 148. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub, to 3 m high. Leaves thin coriaceous, oblong to elliptic, 5–8 by 2–3.5 cm; apex acuminate or abruptly acute; base cuneate; petiole 2–4 mm long; veins on larger leaves strongly sunken below. Bracteoles and sepals not clearly differentiated. Petals white, 5–6, oblong or obovate, briefly connate below, 0.8–1.4 cm long, concave. Outer stamens briefly connate below. Ovary hirsute; styles 3, slender, free to the base. Fruit 2–3-lobed, 3–3.5 cm across, 1.5–2 cm high. Seeds subglobose, ca 1.5 cm across.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Camellia tenii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 146. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Much branched climber with twining terete stems which often preserve their freshness after the fall of the leaves, and are loaded with fruits then, 2–5(–9) m. Leaves remote, polymorphous, broadly ovate in outline with a cordate base, generally ± deeply or irregularly 3–5(–9)-lobed, apex acutish, lobes acute or obtuse, lamina occasionally entire or almost so (resembling then those of the East Malesian ca moluccana Bl.), herbaceous, (4–)6–12(–17) by (3–)4–7–(–16) cm, main nerves 7–9 radiating from apex of petiole, the latter (3–)5–12 cm. Panicles solitary on 3–5(–10) cm long peduncles, 1–2(–3)-forked, cincinni rather few-flowered, glandular-puberulous initially, 5–10 cm, accrescent in fruiting stage. Flowers white. Fruit obovate-elliptic in outline, including the flat stramineous and densely parallel-veined wings 18-28 by 12–18 mm, tipped by the accrescent style which remains green and succulent for a long time.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Grass-like herb 10–20 cm high, with numerous, thin roots. Leaves tufted, 10–15cm long, with a very narrow ciliated band along the margin. Inflorescence apical on a 10–20 cm long cylindric scape, up to twice as long as the leaves, pubescent especially in the basal part. Lower bract oval, 8 mm X 7 mm, pubescent, supporting up to 12 flowers; upper bract slightly smaller. Flowers sessile, shorter than the bracts, ca 1 mm; bracteoles 2, hyaline, 6 mm long 2–3 mm broad, dentate at apex. Stamen 1. Carpels 5–7. Fruit 0.75 mm X 0.5 mm, ovoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Centrolepis cambodiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 2, 1972. Pg. 161. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: A medium-sized tree, bark brownish, smooth, defoliating inlongitudinal scrolls Leaves 2–5 by 0.2–0.4 cm, glossy green above, white beneath; apex acute; base rounded truncate or partly subcordate. Seed ellipsoid, ± 1.2 by 2.5 cm, with a short apical point and attenuate towards the base.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Leaves coriaceous, oblong or oblong-oblanceolate, 6–9 by 3–4 cm; the margin entire; apex obtusely acuminate; base cuneate; petiole 1–1.5 cm long. Flowers bisexual. Pedicels 1.5–2 cm long. Sepals subequal, orbicular, 3–3. 5 mm long. Petals whitish, ovate-oblong, 7–10 mm long. Stamens 4–6 mm long; anthers 2 mm long, hispid. Fruit globose or ovoid, 8 mm long, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Liana, or at first a shrub. Branchlets densely tomentose. description: Liana or scandent shrub, sometimes a small tree. description: Tree up to 8 m high; trunk cylindric, clothed with compacted woodybases of petioles, often branching when the terminal bud has been cut off. Bark brown, smooth below and tessellated above by the small diamond-shaped scars of fallen leaves. Leaves pinnate 1.5–2.5 m long. Leaflets numerous (80–100 pairs), alternate, linear, 15–30 cm long, 7–12 mm wide, blunt or acute, margins strongly revolute, midrib prominent on both surfaces. Petiole 40–60 cm long with short distant spines at right angles to the petiole or slightly deflexed to near the glabrous base. Leaf bases rusty tomentose. Male cone oblong-ovoid, ca 33 cm long, 7.6 cm diam., slightly stipitate. Microsporophylls long acuminate-rostrate, acumen in upper half of cone strongly reflexed, erect in the lower half. Macrosporophylls 15–20 cm long; sterile part 7.6 X 2.5 cm, rhomboid, tapering into a long acuminate point, strongly dentate, lobate, bearing 2 pairs of ovules above the middle of the stalk. Seed globose, 3.8 cm in diameter, orange red when mature.

description: Shrub normally acaulescent, in an extreme condition producing a shortstem about 20 cm above the ground. Leaves 115–150 cm long, 18–19 leaflets on each side of the rachis. Male cone subcylindric, more or less attenuate towards both ends, 15–21 cm by 2–4 cm; peduncle 3–3.5 cm by 1.2 cm, with rusty tomentose scales. Microsporophylls subspathulate, apiculate, 1.4 cm long, 0.8–1 cm at the widest; outside glabrous, inside rusty tomentose. Macrosporophylls 8–12 cm long; sterile part 3.5 cm wide rhomboid, rusty tomentose, deeply pectinate-lacerate with long acuminate, glabrous points, median segment broadest; bearing one pair of ovules at the middle. Seed broad elliptic, 2.5–2.7 X 2 cm, dark green, only one developed.

description: Dioecious tree or shrub up to 5 m high, producing suckers freely. Trunk 1–4 m high, rarely branching, rough with old leaf bases. Leaves pinnate, 60–180 cm long, lanate when young. description: Tree 3–7 m high, trunk rough, simple or sometimes forked; often with bud sprouts towards the base. Leaves 1–2 m long, closely whorled at the top of the stem, dark green, glossy; leaflets 50–60 pairs, 20–38 cm long, 1.2–1.7 cm wide, confluent in the upper part of the leaf, linear-acute, coriaceous, midrib grooved on both surfaces; petiole very broad at the base, thorny. Leaf bases greyish brown, tomentose. Male cone about 30 cm long, about 10 cm across, orange-coloured, coarsely scented. Microsporophylls about 2 cm long, obcuneate with a fairly long upcurved, not spinescent acumen. Macrosporophylls about 23 cm long, 1.2 cm wide; sterile part ovate to ovate-lanceolate, densely villous, teeth small. Ovules 4 pairs in the notches below the sterile part. description: Small rosette shrub, often stemless but at times with a trunk up to 150 cm high, base abruptly swollen, trunk cylindric, smooth. Leaves 60–90 cm long, rusty villous while young, stiff, spreading. Leaflets about 70 pairs 7.5–20.5 cm long, 6 mm wide, linear, mucronate-acuminate; midrib prominent on both surfaces. Petiole about 30 cm long, thorny. Leaf bases brown villous. Male cone oblong about 30 cm long. Microsporophylls 17 mm long with a slender terminal point as long as the deltoid clavate limb. Macrosporophylls 10–10.5 cm long, at first densely tawny tomentose, then nearly glabrous; sterile part ovate-rhomboid, 2–2.5cm diameter, margin deeply pectinate, lacerate, with spinous teeth 2.5–5 cm long. description: Deciduous trees up to 14 m, flowering with or before new leaves. description: Evergreen trees up to 40 m. Leaves elliptic to oblong, 15–30 by 7–10 cm, 10–14-nerved, rounded to acute at apex, acute at base. Petiole 2–5 cm. description: Perennial glabrous climber up to 20 m long; stem ± woody at the base, hard-herbaceous upwards with a diameter of 2–8 mm. description: Perennial herb, varying in vegetative parts from relatively small, terrestrial plants to large swamp aquatics; hairy when young, glabrous when full grown. The aquatic form has (particularly when old) long, floating stolons covered by the leaf sheaths. Stems 0.5–2 m high, 1–1.5 cm diam. in upper part. Leaves for the greater part crowded at the base of the plant, erect, coriaceous, lanceolate, acuminate, 20–120 cm long, 1.5–15 cm broad, with close set longitudinal nerves and numerous thin cross nervules. The lower leaves long petioled, the upper ones ± sessile. Lower leaf sheaths long and broad, gradually narrowed into the petiole. Inflorescence a pedunculate panicle 20–120 cm long with coarse main branches. Lower bracts very variable in size. Flowers unisexual, solitary or in small clusters supported by short bracts, the ♂ branches usually thinner and longer than the ♀. Perianth yellowish green to whitish, on the inner side dotted with red. description: Shrub or small tree. description: Perennial tufted herb up to 1 m high. description: Perennial, glabrous, polymorphous herb 15–100 cm high, ± tufted, erect or prostrate or floating in lakes, branches cylindrical. description: Parasitic, fleshy, yellowish white to brown plants destitute of chlorophyll; total length 2.3–15 cm. Tuber subspherical, 0.7–2.5 cm diam. Stem 0.6–1.5 cm wide. description: Tuber broadly cupular. Stem short, much depressed, about 1 cm long at most. Leaves about 10, broadly triangular or semicircular, obtuse, covering lower part of perianth tube. Anthers 20, sessile on the column immediately below the widened part, 2-celled, opening with a pore. In the female flower the column is considerably thicker; here 20 small outgrowths are found at the same position as the anthers; they have been interpreted as rudimentary anthers or stigmatoid tissue respectively. description: Tree 15–20 m tall. Leaves subcoriaceous, oblong or oblanceolate, 7–15(–17) by 2.5–5.5(–6.5) cm; apex abruptly acute; base cuneate; margin entire; petiole 1.5–2 cm long. description: Small shrub or small creeping or climbing liana. Branches smooth. Leaves elliptic to oblong or obovate, mostly 6–10 by 3–5 cm, obtuse to acute at apex, acute at base. Petiole 6–10 mm. Inflorescences up to 8 by 6 cm, mostly 4–7-, up to 12-flowered. Flowers ca 2.5 cm across, on 8–15 mm long pedicel. Sepals 4, ca 8–10 by 7–9 mm. Petals (3–)4(–5), ca 12–15 by 6–8 mm, reddish white. Stamens 6–8 mm long. Carpels 3–4, glabrous except for a few hairs along the suture, with ca 10–15 ovules. Follicles almost globular, ca 10 mm in diameter with 2–6 mm long beak, 1–7-, usually 2-seeded. Seeds ovoid, 3–4 by 2–3 mm, with 8–10 mm long bright red aril.

description: Woody vine. Branches sparsely strigose, glabrescent, sometimes slightly scabrid. Inflorescences up to 20 by 10 cm, up to 80-flowered. Flowers 8–11 mm across, on 3–7 mm long pedicel. Sepals 5, 2 outer ones ca 5 by 3.5 mm, 3 inner ones ca 7 by 5 mm. Petals 3, ca 5 by 2.5 mm, white or pink. Stamens 4–5 mm long. Carpels (2–)3, glabrous, with 8–16 ovules. Follicles ovoid, ca 7–8 by 5–6 mm, acute with 2 mm long beak, 1–2-seeded. Seeds globular, 2–3 mm in diameter, with asymmetric aril up to 6 mm long.
